title: Molecular Mechanisms of Notopterygii rhizoma Et Radix for Treating Arrhythmia Based on Network Pharmacology.
authors: Wei, Penglu; Shang, Juju; Liu, Hongxu; Xing, Wenlong; Tan, Yupei
one_liner_zh: 该文基于网络药理学和分子对接研究羌活治疗心律失常的机制，虽涉及分子对接但核心为药物-靶点网络与通路分析，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: To explore the possible mechanism for treating NRR in arrhythmia using network pharmacology and molecular docking in this study. METHODS: Active compounds and targets for NRR were retrieved from the Traditional Chinese Medicine Systems Pharmacology (TCMSP) Database and Analysis Platform, SymMap, and the Encyclopedia of Traditional Chinese Medicine (ETCM) databases. Arrhythmia-related genes were acquired from the Comparative Toxicogenomics Database (CTD) and the GeneCards database. Overlapping targets of NRR associated with arrhythmia were acquired and displayed via a Venn diagram. DAVID was applied for GO and KEGG pathway analyses. Cytoscape software and its plug-in were used for PPI network construction, module division and hub nodes screening. Auto- Dock Vina and qRT-PCR were carried out for validation. RESULTS: In total, 21 active compounds and 57 targets were obtained. Of these, coumarin was the predominant category which contained 15 components and 31 targets. There were 5 key targets for NRR in treating arrhythmia. These targets are involved in the apoptotic process, extrinsic apoptotic signaling pathway in the absence of ligand, and endopeptidase activity involved in the apoptotic process by cytochrome c. The main pathways were the p53 signaling pathway, Hepatitis B and apoptosis. The molecular docking and qRT-PCR displayed good effects on hub node regulation in NRR treatment. CONCLUSION: NRR plays an important role in anti-apoptotic mechanisms that modulate the p53 signaling pathway, which may provide insight for future research and clinical applications focusing on arrhythmia therapy.
abstract_zh: 目的：本研究通过网络药理学和分子对接技术，探讨宁心复脉（NRR）治疗心律失常的可能机制。方法：从传统中药系统药理学数据库与分析平台（TCMSP）、SymMap及中药百科全书（ETCM）数据库中检索NRR的活性化合物及其靶点。心律失常相关基因来源于比较毒物基因组学数据库（CTD）和GeneCards数据库。通过维恩图获取并展示NRR与心律失常相关的重叠靶点。利用DAVID进行GO和KEGG通路分析。采用Cytoscape软件及其插件进行蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络构建、模块划分及核心节点筛选。通过AutoDock Vina和qRT-PCR进行验证。结果：共获得21个活性化合物和57个靶点。其中，香豆素类为主要类别，包含15个成分和31个靶点。NRR治疗心律失常的关键靶点有5个。这些靶点涉及凋亡过程、无配体条件下的外源性凋亡信号通路，以及细胞色素c介导的凋亡过程中的内肽酶活性。主要通路包括p53信号通路、乙型肝炎和凋亡通路。分子对接和qRT-PCR结果显示，NRR治疗对核心节点调控具有良好的效果。结论：NRR在调节p53信号通路的抗凋亡机制中发挥重要作用，这可能为未来聚焦于心律失常治疗的研究和临床应用提供见解。
